progressBasis: separate learn-brand, first design-host, and held-out-reuse evidence; design-host coverage is never the total program proxy

learn-brand.nextAction: Do not change learned rules for this held-out host unless the case exposes a genuine cross-case methodology defect.

remainingGap: V2-D prechange structural baseline is historically unrecoverable
design-host.nextAction: Keep first-host result frozen; do not use second host to rewrite its history.

held-out-reuse.nextAction: Keep the frozen MOD and held-out evidence unchanged; use a new unrelated host for any future generalization claim.

heldOutExitCriterion: 同一冻结 ONE PIECE MOD 与角色能力模型，在不新增 card-plugin2 专用流程规则的情况下，6/6 配置路由通过 structural diff、business safety、runtime/theme、visual-system conformance 与 fresh independent QA。

caseSpecificRuleBudget.handling: 若出现缺失的一般规则，先判 held-out FAIL；只有跨 case 合理且经 Methodology Keeper 验证后才能更新方法并从头重跑。
